_note: woo-stages-are-guarded-by-their-flow, decisions D1 and D3 (Ruben, 14 October). Generic case fields a flow can ask for, named by what they record, not by a procedure. documentSearchOutcome and documentSearchNote: the handler records that a search for documents found nothing, and why; the documentAssessment guard then counts the case as assessed, and a decision-only publication is allowed (D2). inadmissibilityReason: why a request is not admissible, which a flow waits for before it closes the case from its admissibility check. No defaults: a case that never records them carries none, so the Data tab section stays hidden.

documentSearchOutcome.title: Search outcome
documentSearchOutcome.description: Whether the search for the documents this case is about found any. Recorded by the handler.

documentSearchNote.title: Search note
documentSearchNote.description: Where was searched and why nothing was found. Needed before a case with nothing found moves on.

inadmissibilityReason.title: Reason not admissible
inadmissibilityReason.description: Why the request is not admissible. Needed before the case closes from its admissibility check.
